Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a sales tax refund for low-income students.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales tax refunds for lowincome students; andadding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Resident taxpayers are eligible for a refund of sales tax collectedunder RCW 82.08.020 on a quarterly basis if they: (1) Have qualifiedfor the state need grant for higher education; or (2) are eligible forthe federal food stamp program or statefunded basic food benefits; and(3) are enrolled in an institution eligible to serve students receivingfinancial aid under the federal higher education act. To receive therefund, taxpayers must return a completed quarterly refund form to thedepartment. The quarterly refund is equal to three hundred dollars or.00625 times the state's median income as determined by the employmentsecurity department, whichever is higher.
